title: Tabular Foundation Models for Weighted Regression and Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.29789v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Weighted regression and classification have applications ranging from missing-data analysis and causal inference to insurance pricing and particle physics. Existing weighted methods must be fitted and tuned on each dataset, which is costly for flexible nonlinear learners. Tabular foundation models avoid this cost. A Transformer is pretrained once on many simulated datasets and then predicts on a new dataset by in-context learning, using its observations as context without further fitting. Recent models such as TabPFN-3.5 surpass tuned conventional methods, but they cannot use sample weights. We develop a general pipeline that adapts such models to weighted prediction through weighted attention, a normalized weighted loss, and pretraining on synthetic weighted prediction tasks from missing-data problems. translated_title: 用于加权回归与分类的表格基础模型
translated_abstract: 加权回归与分类的应用范围广泛，涵盖缺失数据分析、因果推断、保险定价以及粒子物理学等领域。现有的加权方法必须在每个数据集上进行拟合与调优，这对于灵活的非线性学习器而言代价高昂。表格基础模型可以避免这一成本：Transformer 在众多模拟数据集上仅预训练一次，随后通过上下文学习在新数据集上进行预测，将观测数据作为上下文使用，无需进一步拟合。近期诸如 TabPFN-3.5 等模型已超越经过调优的传统方法，但它们无法利用样本权重。我们开发了一套通用流程，通过加权注意力机制、归一化加权损失，以及基于缺失数据问题生成的合成加权预测任务的预训练，将此类模型适配到加权预测中。将该流程应用于 TabPFN-3.5，我们得到了 WeightedPFN，它在真实数据集上表现强劲，在缺失数据问题和分布外场景中均有出色表现。
tldr: 提出了 WeightedPFN，通过加权注意力、归一化加权损失以及基于缺失数据问题的合成加权任务预训练，将表格基础模型 TabPFN-3.5 适配到加权回归与分类中，在真实数据集上表现优异。
en_tdlr: WeightedPFN adapts tabular foundation models like TabPFN-3.5 to weighted regression and classification through weighted attention, normalized weighted loss, and pretraining on synthetic weighted prediction tasks, achieving strong performance on real datasets including missing-data problems.
